ADOPTION.NOT_AVAILABLE: This animal is already {{status}}. You can view its profile, but you can't submit a new request.
ADOPTION.DEFAULT_HISTORY: This little one is waiting for a family that gives them a second chance.
ADOPTION.STEP_FICHA_TEXT: You are here. Read carefully about its health needs and requirements.
ADOPTION.STEP_FORM_TEXT: Fill in the official form with your details.
ADOPTION.STEP_TRACK_TEXT: We'll review your profile and get in touch.
ADOPTION.DEFAULT_THINGS: They will need time and patience to adapt to their new home.
ADOPTION.DEFAULT_REQUIREMENTS: Phone interview and signing of the adoption contract is mandatory.
ADOPTION.FORM_SUBTITLE: Please complete your details to submit the request. This information is confidential.
ADOPTION.GARDEN: Do you have a fenced garden or terrace?
ADOPTION.OTHER_PETS: Do you currently live with other pets?
ADOPTION.FOLLOW_UP_VISITS: Do you agree to follow-up visits?
ADOPTION.SUCCESS_TEXT: We have received your form to adopt {{name}}.
ADOPTION.SUCCESS_DETAILS: Our team will review your profile within the next 48 hours. If it matches the animal's needs, we will contact you by phone to schedule the follow-up interview.
ADOPTION.TRACKING_REVIEW_TEXT: We have received your form correctly. Our team is evaluating your profile to make sure it is the ideal home for {{name}}. We will contact you soon by phone or email to let you know if you move forward.
ADOPTION.TRACKING_RESERVED_TEXT: Your request has moved forward or the animal is in pre-adoption! The animal's status is {{status}}. Keep an eye on your email, our team is making decisions at this stage.
ADOPTION.TRACKING_DONE_TEXT: The adoption process for {{name}} has officially concluded and they now have a home. If you were the lucky one, congratulations! If it didn't work out this time, we warmly encourage you to keep exploring the gallery. There are so many pets that need you!
ADOPTION.LOGIN_REQUIRED: You must log in to submit a request.
ADOPTION.SEND_ERROR: The request could not be sent. Check the data and try again.

POPUP.TEXT1: Adopting is an act of love, but above all a lifelong responsibility.
